from std.ffi import external_call, c_int

var n = external_call["abs", c_int](c_int(-42))
```

](...)
```

## Gives it the C calling convention so C can call it

```
def compare(
    a: OpaquePointer[mut=False, _],
    b: OpaquePointer[mut=False, _],
) abi("C") -> c_int:
    ...
```

Required for callbacks — a comparison function handed to `qsort`, say. Such a function captures no Mojo state.

## `OwnedDLHandle`

```
from std.ffi import OwnedDLHandle, c_double

var lib = OwnedDLHandle("libm.so.6")
var sqrt = lib.get_function[c_double]("sqrt")
```

It owns the handle with RAII semantics, so the library is unloaded when it dies.
